# Domain-Layered Engine Structure (Option B)

## Overview

Deepen the Angular-style file system (wiki:specs/angular-style-file-system) into a domain-layered structure: each domain folder owns its model + rules + application + data sub-layers; cross-cutting plumbing lives in `shared/`. The old `services/` grab-bag, `helpers/`, and root `data.ts` are dissolved — every export now lives in the domain it belongs to. Pure structural refactor, zero behavior change.

Derived from research (feature-sliced design, module-per-domain, Evans application-vs-domain services) + a codebase coupling map that found: a 547-line `engine.service.ts` god module mixing battle/cards/units/deck logic, `data.ts` mixing cards+units data, and a runtime `effects ↔ engine` cycle.

## Decisions

- D1: **Per-domain sub-layers** — each domain gets `model/` (types), `rules/` (domain rules), `application/` (orchestration over rules), `data/` (content). Flat one-type-per-file + barrel convention preserved (D2/D3 of angular-style-file-system).
- D2: **Domain ownership** — `cards/` owns the effect resolver (application) + targeting rules + card library/JSON; `units/` owns combat rules + hero/enemy/goon defs; `battle/` owns board/state/turn rules + player actions + command queue + undo/redo session; new `deck/` owns draw/shuffle + hand constants.
- D3: **Player actions are application orchestration** — `moveUnit`, `unitAttack`, `castCard`, `sellCard`, `buyCard` live in `battle/application/actions.service.ts` (they orchestrate across domains on battle state). Card *rules* (`canCast`, `cardTargets`) stay in `cards/rules/`.
- D4: **Cross-cutting plumbing in `shared/helpers`** — `nid`, `resetIds`, `log`, `posKey`, `cellLabel`, `heroUnit`, `clone` (pure, type-only imports). `icons` moved OUT of the engine to `src/components/game/card-icons.ts` (it imports lucide-react — presentation, not engine).
- D5: **Cycle-breaking import rule** — cross-domain value imports target the *leaf segment* when the full domain barrel would create a runtime cycle: cards/units/deck/shared import `battle/model` (runtime-leaf) directly, never the battle barrel. `battle/application → cards barrel → battle/model` is acyclic. Type-only imports of any barrel are always safe (erased).
- D6: **Duplicate code removed** — effects.service's private `dealDamage`/`drawCards`/`shuffle` are replaced by the shared `units/rules/combat` and `deck/rules` versions; the `effects ↔ engine` cycle is gone.

## Target Structure

```
src/lib/game/
├── index.ts                  # root barrel: battle+cards+units+deck+shared
├── cards/
│   ├── model/                # CardDef, CardEffect, CardInstance, CardTarget, CardType
│   ├── rules/                # targeting.service (canCast, cardTargets)
│   ├── application/          # effects.service (resolver + custom registry)
│   └── data/                 # schema.helper, card-library, starter-deck, pack-01-starter.json
├── units/
│   ├── model/                # Team, UnitKind, Unit
│   ├── rules/                # combat.service (effAtk, dealDamage, cleanupDead)
│   └── data/                 # hero-def, enemy-spawns, goon-def, EnemySpawn
├── battle/
│   ├── model/                # GameState, FxEvent, FxKind, Phase, Pos, LogEntry, board constants
│   ├── rules/                # board.service, state.service, turn.service (+EnemyStepKind)
│   └── application/          # actions.service, commands.service, session.service (GameSession)
├── deck/
│   └── rules/                # deck.service (shuffle, drawCards, HAND_MAX/HAND_START)
└── shared/
    └── helpers/              # engine.helper (nid, resetIds, log, posKey, cellLabel, heroUnit, clone)
```

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] AC-1: `services/`, `helpers/`, and root `data.ts` no longer exist under `src/lib/game/`; every export lands in a domain sub-layer or `shared/`.
- [ ] AC-2: `engine.service.ts` god module decomposed — no file exceeds a single domain responsibility.
- [ ] AC-3: Runtime dependency graph is acyclic (grep: no cross-domain value-imports of the battle barrel from cards/units/deck/shared; only type-only or `battle/model` imports).
- [ ] AC-4: `effects ↔ engine` cycle eliminated; duplicated `dealDamage`/`drawCards`/`shuffle` removed.
- [ ] AC-5: `icons` (lucide-react) no longer imported anywhere under `src/lib/game/`.
- [ ] AC-6: `tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm test` green (66 tests, no tests removed or weakened); `npm run build` green.
- [ ] AC-7: Consumers import from domain barrels only; no stale `services`/`helpers` import paths remain (grep-verifiable).

## Related

- @wiki/specs/angular-style-file-system (superseded layering: its services/helpers folders are replaced by sub-layers + shared)
- @wiki/rules/spec-driven-development, @wiki/rules/tdd
- @wiki/memory/domain-driven-barrel-structure (earlier Rust-era pattern, same barrel idea)

# Domain-Layered Engine Structure (Option B)

## Overview

Deepen the Angular-style file system (wiki:specs/angular-style-file-system) into a domain-layered structure: each domain folder owns its model + rules + data sub-layers; the game's application layer (use-cases, command queue, session) lives at the top level; cross-cutting plumbing lives in `shared/`. The old `services/` grab-bag, `helpers/`, and root `data.ts` are dissolved — every export now lives where it belongs. Pure structural refactor, zero behavior change.

Derived from research (feature-sliced design, module-per-domain, Evans application-vs-domain services) + a codebase coupling map that found: a 547-line `engine.service.ts` god module mixing battle/cards/units/deck logic, `data.ts` mixing cards+units data, and a runtime `effects ↔ engine` cycle.

## Decisions

- D1: **Per-domain sub-layers** — each domain gets `model/` (types), `rules/` (domain rules), `data/` (content). Flat one-type-per-file + barrel convention preserved (D2/D3 of angular-style-file-system).
- D2: **Domain ownership** — `cards/` owns the effect resolver (application) + targeting rules + card library/JSON; `units/` owns combat rules + hero/enemy/goon defs; `battle/` owns board/state/turn rules; new `deck/` owns draw/shuffle + hand constants.
- D3: **Application is a game-level layer, not battle's** (Evans: one application layer per bounded context). `src/lib/game/application/` holds: `actions.service` (player use-cases — move/attack/cast/sell/buy orchestrate across cards+units+battle rules), `commands.service` (PlayerCommand + executeCommand + CommandQueue — the deterministic action bus), `session.service` (GameSession undo/redo). This layer was initially nested under `battle/application/` and extracted when review flagged that it orchestrates the whole game (D3 amended 2026-08-04).
- D4: **Cross-cutting plumbing in `shared/helpers`** — `nid`, `resetIds`, `log`, `posKey`, `cellLabel`, `heroUnit`, `clone` (pure, type-only imports). `icons` moved OUT of the engine to `src/components/game/card-icons.ts` (it imports lucide-react — presentation, not engine).
- D5: **Cycle-breaking import rule** — cross-domain value imports target the *leaf segment* when the full domain barrel would create a runtime cycle: cards/units/deck/shared import `battle/model` (runtime-leaf) directly, never the battle barrel. `application → cards barrel → battle/model` is acyclic. Type-only imports of any barrel are always safe (erased).
- D6: **Duplicate code removed** — effects.service's private `dealDamage`/`drawCards`/`shuffle` are replaced by the shared `units/rules/combat` and `deck/rules` versions; the `effects ↔ engine` cycle is gone.
- D7: **Child-domain escalation path** — vertical child domains (each unit as its own domain with internal layers) are deferred until a unit gains distinct responsibilities + its own model footprint. The known candidate: `run/`/`session` becomes a top-level domain when save/load + run/combat state split lands (persistence) — GameSession is already game-level, not battle-internal (D3).

## Target Structure

```
src/lib/game/
├── index.ts                  # root barrel: application+battle+cards+units+deck+shared
├── application/              # game use-cases + bus + session (D3)
│   ├── actions.service.ts    # moveUnit, unitAttack, castCard, sellCard, buyCard, BUY_COST
│   ├── commands.service.ts   # PlayerCommand, executeCommand, CommandQueue
│   └── session.service.ts    # GameSession (undo/redo, end-turn commit)
├── cards/
│   ├── model/                # CardDef, CardEffect, CardInstance, CardTarget, CardType
│   ├── rules/                # targeting.service (canCast, cardTargets)
│   ├── application/          # effects.service (resolver + custom registry)
│   └── data/                 # schema.helper, card-library, starter-deck, pack-01-starter.json
├── units/
│   ├── model/                # Team, UnitKind, Unit
│   ├── rules/                # combat.service (effAtk, dealDamage, cleanupDead)
│   └── data/                 # hero-def, enemy-spawns, goon-def, EnemySpawn
├── battle/
│   ├── model/                # GameState, FxEvent, FxKind, Phase, Pos, LogEntry, board constants
│   └── rules/                # board.service, state.service, turn.service (+EnemyStepKind)
├── deck/
│   └── rules/                # deck.service (shuffle, drawCards, HAND_MAX/HAND_START)
└── shared/
    └── helpers/              # engine.helper (nid, resetIds, log, posKey, cellLabel, heroUnit, clone)
```

Layer rule: shared ← units/deck ← cards ← battle ← application. `cards/`/`units/`/`deck/`/`application/` may import `battle/model` (runtime-leaf) but never the battle barrel (D5).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: `services/`, `helpers/`, and root `data.ts` no longer exist under `src/lib/game/`; every export lands in a domain sub-layer, `application/`, or `shared/`.
- [x] AC-2: `engine.service.ts` god module decomposed — no file exceeds a single domain responsibility.
- [x] AC-3: Runtime dependency graph is acyclic (grep: no cross-domain value-imports of the battle barrel from cards/units/deck/shared/application; only type-only or `battle/model` imports).
- [x] AC-4: `effects ↔ engine` cycle eliminated; duplicated `dealDamage`/`drawCards`/`shuffle` removed.
- [x] AC-5: `icons` (lucide-react) no longer imported anywhere under `src/lib/game/`.
- [x] AC-6: `tsc --noEmit` 0 errors; `npm test` green (66 tests, no tests removed or weakened); `npm run build` green.
- [x] AC-7: Consumers import from domain barrels only; no stale `services`/`helpers` import paths remain (grep-verifiable).
- [x] AC-8: Application layer extracted to game level — `battle/application/` no longer exists; consumers (hook, tests, components) import `GameSession`/`CommandQueue`/`BUY_COST`/`castCard` from the game root barrel.

Verified 2026-08-04 (after D3 extraction): tsc 0, 66/66 tests, next build green, zero stale services/helpers refs, only type-only battle-barrel imports remain in leaf model files (erased at compile).

## Related

- @wiki/specs/angular-style-file-system (superseded layering: its services/helpers folders are replaced by sub-layers + shared)
- @wiki/rules/spec-driven-development, @wiki/rules/tdd
- @wiki/memory/domain-driven-barrel-structure (earlier Rust-era pattern, same barrel idea)
